learning_objective: 🎯 In this inspiring poem, we will learn the golden rule of success: never giving up, facing our failures with courage, and trying again until we win!

main_concepts.concept_title: 🌟 The Golden Rule (If at first you don't succeed...)
main_concepts.simple_explanation: The poem teaches us a very simple but powerful lesson: if we fail at something on our first try, we should not cry or give up. Instead, we must gather our energy and try again!
Many people feel ashamed when they lose or make a mistake. The poet reminds us that failing is completely normal and not a disgrace. True failure only happens when we stop trying.
Success is not a magic trick; it requires a lot of patience and hard work. When tasks seem too difficult, we just need to keep practicing, and eventually, we will conquer the challenge!

fun_activity.title: 🏆 My 'Try Again' Story!
fun_activity.instructions: Think of a time when you failed at something (like riding a bicycle, solving a math problem, or playing a game) but eventually won because you tried again. Write a small 3-sentence story about your victory!

quick_recap: ⭐ The poem encourages us to be brave and keep trying whenever we face difficulties.
⭐ There is absolutely no shame in failing; the only shame is in giving up.
⭐ With patience and continuous effort, we can achieve even the hardest goals.
⭐ Every failure is actually a stepping stone towards our final success.
